cases.plugin_name: HUSKY - Products Filter Professional for WooCommerce
cases.description: Unauthenticated Local File Inclusion
cases.notes: The real public patch is revision-backed, not zip-backed. NVD and Wordfence point to ext/by_text/index.php in the unauthenticated woof_text_search AJAX path, and WP.org changeset 3249621 inserts `$template = sanitize_key($template);` immediately before the template path is built. Later WP.org readmes explicitly list a separate 1.3.6.6 Wordfence fix, but public 1.3.6.5 and 1.3.6.6 zip or tag materialization is still inconsistent through normal downloads. Current 1.3.8.1 include scans still hit a different helper include at ext/by_text/index.php:569, not the template branch itself. Keep metadata-only until a durable vulnerable fixture is materialized or a revision-backed file-slice contract is added.

cases.plugin_name: Contact Form Plugin by Fluent Forms for Quiz, Survey, and Drag & Drop WP Form Builder
cases.description: Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Form Subject
cases.notes: The old 'form subject' note here is stale. The vendor changelog confirms 5.2.7 as the fixed release, but the public 5.2.6 to 5.2.7 diff does not support a pinned subject-render XSS path. The clearest security-relevant public code change is in boot/globals.php, where 5.2.7 stops recursively trusting attacker-controlled array keys and rebuilds nested input arrays with sanitize_text_field() applied to each key before recursing. Other visible PHP diffs, including app/Services/Transfer/TransferService.php note-export changes, do not ground the claimed unauthenticated 'form subject' family either. Full output reruns on vulnerable 5.2.6 and current 6.1.20 still produce only unrelated admin/rest or payment disclosure findings. Keep metadata-only until the real vulnerable source and sink family for CVE-2024-10646 is pinned from a trustworthy advisory or patch.

cases.plugin_name: Ninja Forms - The Contact Form Builder That Grows With You
cases.description: Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Form Calculations
cases.notes: Direct phparser compare now requires both the real vulnerable calculations metabox output sinks and the real stored-write AJAX entrypoints in includes/AJAX/Controllers/Submission.php, instead of pinning the visible read-bridge source in includes/Abstracts/Model.php. In vulnerable 3.8.19, includes/Templates/admin-metaboxes-calcs.html.php still echoes value/raw/parsed at lines 6/8/9 without escaping. Public 3.8.20 and current 3.14.1 wrap those fields with esc_html() and only leave the line-4 name output. The visible trace source for this family is still a persistent-read bridge, but the compare contract is now honest for the cross-request stored-write plus read-to-output behavior.

cases.description: Unauthenticated JSON File Upload to Stored Cross-Site Scripting
cases.notes: The real vulnerable family is the legacy color-scheme import helper in redux-core/inc/extensions/color_scheme/color_scheme/class-redux-color-scheme-import.php, which moves an uploaded JSON file into the Redux upload directory. phparser now has a clean direct match on the narrowed vulnerable color_scheme slice at class-redux-color-scheme-import.php:243 in 4.4.17, and first fixed public 4.4.18 is clean on the same slice. The public 4.4.18 WP.org diff also makes the fixed boundary explicit by removing class-redux-color-scheme-import.php entirely from the color_scheme extension tree. Full-plugin write scans are still too expensive, so this direct contract intentionally uses the self-contained vulnerable sub-tree instead of the whole plugin root.

cases.description: Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation via Registration Role Field
cases.notes: This reduced exact vulnerable fixture preserves the public registration path in 51.1.14 where $_POST['user_role'] flows through handle_register_ajax() into wp_insert_user($user_data) at Login_Register_Form_Ajax.php:351. The generic phparser fix models wp_insert_user/wp_update_user role writes as privilege-mutation sinks while suppressing the common low-privilege allowlist shape used by fixed 51.1.35, where the requested role is clamped to subscriber/customer before the insert.

cases.description: Missing Authorization to Authenticated (Subscriber+) Arbitrary File Read
cases.notes: Exact vulnerable 4.23.81 preserves the low-privilege GOTMLS_ajax_scan path where $_GET["GOTMLS_scan"] is decoded and then read through file_get_contents($real_file) at index.php:1858. Fixed 4.23.83 adds GOTMLS_kill_invalid_user() to the handler family; current phparser now models that helper as an authenticated-path statement guard, but the raw read finding still remains on both exact tags, so this corpus row is vulnerable-fixture-only rather than a clean vulnerable-vs-fixed separator.
